scope: synthetic finite-action population and paired Monte Carlo; not language-model evidence

finite_sample.ranking_bits: BT; conditionally independent of Gaussian rating noise
finite_sample.sampling: uniform unordered distinct pairs; shared observations across weights
finite_sample.confidence_intervals: paired differences mean +/- 1.96 Monte Carlo standard errors; descriptive, no multiplicity-adjusted discovery claim

preexecution_note: Written before running this sweep. Grid is a feasibility design, not registered externally. All configured instances and weights will be reported, including null/beneficial results. Changes require a separate recorded run.
